hero.title: Sell your own wine, at your own price, to the people drinking it
hero.lead: You already grow it, make it and bottle it. On Go Wine Go you also sell it — as the licensed seller, at a price you set, to a customer whose name you know.

maths.title: What a case is actually worth to you
maths.note: Illustrative only. A worked example on a $240 case of 12, using indicative trade margins. Your own numbers will differ and nothing here is a quote.
maths.footnote: The difference is not a discount you have to fund. It is the margin that currently sits with two intermediaries between you and the person drinking the wine.

territory.title: You decide which postcodes you will not sell into
territory.lead: This is the part most wineries ask about first, so it is worth being plain. Selling direct does not mean selling over the top of the people who already stock you.
points: You set a postcode exclusion list on your profile, and you can change it whenever you like.
A customer in an excluded postcode never sees your listing. Not greyed out, not 'unavailable' — it does not appear in their market at all.
So an on-premise account or a retailer in your protected territory keeps its territory, and the customer there keeps buying from them.
The exclusions are yours. Go Wine Go does not set them, cannot override them, and does not surface which wineries exclude which postcodes.
territory.example: A winery with a strong Perth CBD retail account excludes 6000 to 6005. Its wines sell direct everywhere else in the country and are invisible in the city block that account works.

paid.title: You are the seller, so you are the one who gets paid

items.name: You remain the licensed seller
items.text: The sale is yours, made under your own producer's licence. Go Wine Go never takes title to the wine and is never the seller of record.

items.name: The customer is charged directly
items.text: Payment is taken at checkout and held by the payment provider. Go Wine Go does not hold your money at any point.

items.name: You invoice the customer
items.text: The tax invoice is yours to the customer, in your name, with your ABN and licence number on it.

items.name: Funds release on delivery
items.text: Upload proof of delivery and the funds release. Money moves when the case is signed for, not before and not weeks after.

cost.title: Commission on a sale, and nothing else

items.label: Commission on the sale price, deducted when funds release
To list a wine, however many you list
Monthly fee, subscription or minimum volume
To run a Go Deal or receive a tender submission

cost.note: If nothing sells, you pay nothing. The commission rate is the one number on this page that is not illustrative.

winescape.title: Your login already works
winescape.text: Go Wine Go runs on the same account as your Winescape bottled-wine trading. You do not create a second company profile or re-enter your licence details.
steps: Sign in with your existing Winescape credentials.
Ask your Company Administrator to grant you the DTC role.
Your company profile, licence details and bank account carry across.
List a wine and you are trading direct.

requirements.title: What you need before you can list
items: A current producer's licence in the state you dispatch from.
The ability to pick, pack and dispatch by the case rather than the bottle.
Access to temperature-controlled freight to the states you sell into.
Someone who can respond to an offer inside the expiry window, usually 72 hours.
